title: Use Conservation of Momentum
text: Derive an equation from $$p_{\text{initial}}=p_{\text{final}},$$ where $$p=m_{1}v_{1}+m_{2}v_{2}$$ for the two satellites. Simplify if needed.

title: Use Conservation of Energy
text: Derive an equation from $$KE_{\text{initial}}=KE_{\text{final}},$$ where $$KE=\tfrac12m_{1}v_{1}**2+\tfrac12m_{2}v_{2}**2$$ for the two satellites. Simplify if needed.

title: Derive For the Relative Final Velocity
text: Derive an expression for $$v_{1,\text{final}}-v_{2,\text{final}}$$ in terms of $$v_{1,\text{initial}}$$ and $$v_{2,\text{initial}}$$.
